def rnd(A,mode):
    A=np.asarray(A,float)
    if mode=='d3': return np.round(A,3)
    if mode=='d2': return np.round(A,2)
    if mode=='s3':
        e=np.floor(np.log10(np.abs(A)+1e-12)); return np.round(A, -(e-2).astype(int))
    if mode=='s2':
        e=np.floor(np.log10(np.abs(A)+1e-12)); return np.round(A, -(e-1).astype(int))
    return A
def runmod(*modes):
    mats=[rnd(A,m) for A,m in zip((WE,WP,A0,P0,A1,M,WU),modes)]
    return mats
def fwdm(mats):
    WEq,Wpq,A0q,P0q,A1q,Mq,WUq=mats
    E=WEq[Xall]+Wpq[None,:,:]
    s0=np.einsum('bpd,bjd->bpj',E@A0q,E); a0=np.exp(s0-s0.max(2,keepdims=True)); a0/=a0.sum(2,keepdims=True)
    r0=E+np.einsum('bpj,bjd->bpd',a0,E@P0q)
    q=r0[:,5]@A1q; s1=np.einsum('bd,bjd->bj',q,r0)
    a1=np.exp(s1-s1.max(1,keepdims=True)); a1/=a1.sum(1,keepdims=True)
    return (r0[:,5]@WUq+np.einsum('bj,bjd->bd',a1,r0@Mq))
def report(mats,label):

          round(np.mean(pr[d==0]==0),4),round(np.mean(pr[d==2]==2),3))

import numpy as np
def fwd(x):
    E=WE[x]+WP[None]; S=np.einsum('bpd,bjd->bpj',E@A0,E)
    a=np.exp(S-S.max(2,keepdims=True)); a/=a.sum(2,keepdims=True)
    r=E+np.einsum('bpj,bjd->bpd',a,E@P0)
    T=np.einsum('bd,bjd->bj',r[:,5]@A1,r); b=np.exp(T-T.max(1,keepdims=True)); b/=b.sum(1,keepdims=True)
    return r[:,5]@WU+np.einsum('bj,bjd->bd',b,r@M)
lg=fwd(Xall)
print('fidelity check', (lg.argmax(1)==dref).mean(), np.abs(lg-run(Xall)).max())

import numpy as np
def feats(rows):
    n=len(rows); out=[]
    for r in rows:
        f=list(map(int,r))
        nfix=sum(1 for i in range(6) if f[i]==i)
        # cycle decomposition
        seen=[False]*6; cycs=[]
        for s in range(6):
            if seen[s]: continue
            path=[]; pos={}; u=s
            while u not in pos and not seen[u]:
                pos[u]=len(path); path.append(u); u=f[u]
            if u in pos: cycs.append(len(path)-pos[u])
            for v in path: seen[v]=True
        cycs=sorted(cycs)
        n2=sum(1 for c in cycs if c==2); n3=sum(1 for c in cycs if c==3)
        nge4=sum(1 for c in cycs if c>=4)
        cpts=sum(cycs)
        im1=len(set(f)); im2=len(set(f[i] for i in range(6)) if False else {f[i] for i in range(6)})
        f2=[f[f[i]] for i in range(6)]; im2=len(set(f2)); f3=[f[f[f[i]]] for i in range(6)]; im3=len(set(f3))
        pre=[sum(1 for i in range(6) if f[i]==v) for v in range(6)]
        npre0=sum(1 for p in pre if p==0); maxpre=max(pre)
        perm=1 if sorted(f)==list(range(6)) else 0
        out.append([nfix,n2,n3,nge4,cpts,im1,im2,im3,npre0,maxpre,perm,1 if n2>0 else 0,1 if n3>0 else 0])
    return np.array(out,dtype=float)
F=feats(Xall)
F=np.hstack([F,np.ones((len(F),1))])
# regress logit differences to class2 and class1 and class0 baseline? use logits
Y=lg
coef,res,rank,sv=np.linalg.lstsq(F,Y,rcond=None)
P=F@coef
print('R2 per logit', 1-((P-Y)**2).sum(0)/((Y-Y.mean(0))**2).sum(0))
print('argmax fid', (P.argmax(1)==dref).mean())
print('per class', [ (P.argmax(1)[dref==k]==k).mean().round(4) for k in range(4)])
